entities.summary: Gavril Ivanovich Tanfilyev was a Russian and Soviet soil scientist and botanist who worked on biogeography and aspects of plants ecology associated with soil and climate and examined the distributional limits of plants. He also produced a classification of the marshes. Gavriil Tanfilyev was a logicians & mathematicians from Tallinn (1857-03-06, Tallinn–1928-09-01). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
